Chord Finder

Pick a chord root and type to see its notes and hear it played.

C
Chord
C – E – G
Notes

Chords are synthesized live with Web Audio. Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose the chord root.
  2. Choose the chord type.
  3. Read the notes and press Play chord.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which chords are supported?

All 12 roots (C through B) and 8 types: major, minor, 7th, maj7, min7, dim, aug and sus4.

Can I hear the chord?

Press the Play chord button to hear every note together, synthesized with Web Audio.

Does it show the notes?

It lists each note by name (for example C – E – G).
